quest.huntcraft.hr4_gansekigani.desc: A horde of Gansekigani is swarming the basalt pillars. Their shells crack best under blunt blows. Slay 8.
quest.huntcraft.hr4_ignivald.desc: A high-rank Ignivald has flown in, drawn by the caldera's heat. Its flames burn fiercer and its rage comes faster. Prepare well.
quest.huntcraft.hr4_jagraptor.desc: High-rank Jagraptors hunt in coordinated packs that overwhelm new hunters. Slay 15 and break the pack.
quest.huntcraft.hr4_lightcrystal.desc: High-rank gear needs Lightcrystals. Find 3 at the mining spots deep in the Verdant Hills' cliffs and cave.
quest.huntcraft.hr4_voltrix.desc: Lightning flashes through the Frostpeak blizzards - surely the work of a high-rank Voltrix. Hunt it.
quest.huntcraft.hr5_blizraptor.desc: High-rank Blizraptors are stalking climbers. Mind their ice breath and slay 15.
quest.huntcraft.hr5_frostgarm.desc: A high-rank Frostgarm rules the Frostpeak summit. Its freezing breath has felled many hunters. Go fully prepared.
quest.huntcraft.hr5_gravadon_capture.des: A Gravadon has strayed into the hills, and we want it alive for study. Once it weakens, use traps and tranq bombs.
quest.huntcraft.hr5_novacrystal.desc: Legendary gear calls for Novacrystals. Dig up 3 in the lava tube or near the craters of the Ember Caldera.
quest.huntcraft.hr6_double.desc: Ignivald and Voltrix have appeared in the Verdant Hills at once. Are you ready to face both? Split them up and take them down one by one.
quest.huntcraft.hr6_frostgarm_capture.de: Capturing a high-rank Frostgarm would greatly advance our cold-climate research. It's dangerous, but you're the only one we can ask.
quest.huntcraft.hr6_gravadon.desc: The largest Gravadon ever seen is shattering the caldera floor. Its blows split boulders - never stand in front of it.
quest.huntcraft.hr6_urgent_azragos.desc: Azragos has returned, burning with even greater power, and the whole caldera is catching fire. This is the final battle, hunter!
quest.huntcraft.lr1_boarfang.desc: Boarfangs keep wrecking my fields. They say you should sidestep the charge and strike from the flank. Please take down 4!
quest.huntcraft.lr1_grasica.desc: The Grasica herds are eating the pastures bare. Hunt 5 to thin the herd - we'll share the meat.
quest.huntcraft.lr1_herb.desc: I'm running out of potion ingredients. Pick 10 Herbs in the Verdant Hills and put them in the delivery box at the base camp.
quest.huntcraft.lr1_jagraptor.desc: Packs of Jagraptors in the Verdant Hills have grown bold and ambush passing merchants. Slay 8 of them and make the trade road safe again.
quest.huntcraft.lr1_mushroom.desc: Blue Mushrooms from the deep forest and the caves make the most nourishing dishes. Bring me 6!
quest.huntcraft.lr2_blizraptor.desc: Blizraptors are packing along the Frostpeak trails. The cold saps your stamina, so don't forget Hot Drinks. Slay 8.
quest.huntcraft.lr2_buzzling.desc: A Buzzling swarm has taken over the flower fields and scared off my bees. Mind the poison stingers and swat 10 of them.
quest.huntcraft.lr2_hot_pepper.desc: We're short on Hot Peppers for Hot Drinks. They grow wild in the Frostpeak taiga - gather 8 for me.
quest.huntcraft.lr2_ice_crystal.desc: I need Ice Crystals to chill Cool Drinks. Mine 6 at the rocky outcrops and the ice cavern of the Frostpeak Range.
quest.huntcraft.lr2_ignivald.desc: The flame-winged Ignivald has nested on the Verdant Hills plateau. Its fire breath from the sky is deadly, but a flash bomb will bring it down. Hunt it.
quest.huntcraft.lr2_voltrix.desc: The thunder-clad Voltrix was sighted by the river in the hills. Its charged body is dangerous - strike whenever it flinches. Hunt it.
quest.huntcraft.lr3_earth_crystal.desc: Earth Crystals are essential for whetstones. Mine 8 of them in the Ember Caldera.
quest.huntcraft.lr3_frostgarm.desc: The ice-fanged Frostgarm has appeared at the summit of the Frostpeak. Its roar is said to call avalanches. Climb the mountain trail and hunt it.
quest.huntcraft.lr3_gravadon.desc: The rock-hammer Gravadon is rampaging in the Ember Caldera and crushed our mine. It's scorching there - take Cool Drinks.
quest.huntcraft.lr3_heatgecko.desc: Heat Geckos have settled in the caldera's mining paths. Watch out for their scorching tackles and clear out 10.
quest.huntcraft.lr3_ignivald_capture.des: We want to study Ignivald alive. When it starts limping, trap it and hit it with 2 tranq bombs. Slaying it fails the quest!
quest.huntcraft.lr3_urgent_azragos.desc: The ancient Netherflame Dragon Azragos has landed on the caldera's rim. The Guild stakes everything to protect the village. Show us your strength!
quest.huntcraft.lr3_yukimammo.desc: Agitated Yukimammo are rampaging on the snowfield and blocking the trade route. Beware their massive charges and hunt 3.
